entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A Kor stoneforger, lithomancer and planeswalker of Zendikar, one of The Three, who was compleated, uncompleated and desparked.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who mentored Nahiri, imprisoned her in the Helvault and became her enemy.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon planeswalker whose breath bound the Eldrazi; the third of The Three.

entities.name: The Three
entities.description: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin, who imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans and broods imprisoned on Zendikar by the hedron network.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan Nahiri summoned to Innistrad.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan imprisoned on Zendikar.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan imprisoned on Zendikar.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: The stone network Nahiri built as the Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A subterranean chamber in Akoum where the imprisonment spell was concentrated.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: An interplanar conqueror whose power Nahiri bound with a hedron.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel who intervened against Nahiri on Innistrad and later encountered her in the Helvault.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The vault in which Sorin imprisoned Nahiri.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: The Markov family manor Nahiri destroyed with lithomancy.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer whose ghouls helped build the Drownyard Temple.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire summoned by Sorin to attack Nahiri.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An animist planeswalker who used the Lithoform Core to restore Zendikar and opposed Nahiri.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who took control of Nahiri's mind and later infected by Vraska on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A Kor warrior hired by Nahiri whom Nahiri pushed from a floating ruin and Nissa saved.

entities.name: Zareth San
entities.description: A hired adventurer killed by Nahiri using the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: An artifact channeling Zendikar's power, which Nissa used to heal the plane.

entities.name: Emeria Skyclave
entities.description: The Skyclave Nahiri reactivated and fused with as a Phyrexian engine.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker found wounded and infected in Sheoldred's Coliseum who infected Jace.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor who compleated Nahiri and sent her to Zendikar.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran who offered to heal Nahiri's phyresis.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A commander who led the party that broke Nahiri loose from the Skyclave.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: An angel in the party that defeated Nahiri.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who found Nahiri after the Skyclave and later on Innistrad.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A werewolf planeswalker and protector of Innistrad who had Nahiri on her hit list.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon whose Immortal Sun trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group Nahiri helped against Bolas.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane where Nahiri was compleated.

entities.name: Phyrexian Nahiri
entities.description: Nahiri's compleated version with blade arms and molten cracks, sent to conquer Zendikar.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Nahiri was imprisoned and later took revenge.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane of the War of the Spark.

events.summary: Nahiri's spark ignites and she lands on Innistrad, where Sorin decides to mentor her.
events.quote: Instead of chasing the young and confused Planeswalker off the plane, Sorin decided to mentor Nahiri

events.summary: The Three plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Sorin lures them, Ugin binds them and Nahiri builds the hedron prison.
events.quote: Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone hedrons

events.summary: The imprisonment succeeds, The Three disband, and Sorin and Ugin leave, promising to come if Nahiri signals.
events.quote: With the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi , the planeswalkers' mission was complete, and The Three disbanded.

events.summary: Nahiri binds Ob Nixilis's power with a hedron before he can do much damage.
events.quote: Nahiri intervened and bound his power with that of a hedron

events.summary: Vampires build a shrine at the hedron nexus, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri wakes, calls unanswered for help and restores it alone.
events.quote: She succeeded on her own in restoring the prison.

events.summary: Nahiri confronts Sorin on Innistrad, threatens him, fights Avacyn and is imprisoned by Sorin in the Helvault.
events.quote: The two fought until Sorin ended the battle by imprisoning Nahiri in the Helvault.

events.summary: With the Helvault sundered, Nahiri returns to a ravaged Zendikar and swears vengeance on Sorin.
events.quote: she swore vengeance against Sorin

events.summary: Nahiri destroys Markov Manor, builds cryptoliths and the Drownyard Temple, and summons Emrakul to Innistrad.
events.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

events.summary: Nahiri wounds and encases Sorin in stone at Markov Manor and planeswalks away.
events.quote: Nahiri was wounded severely but managed to encase Sorin in stone.

events.summary: Nahiri is trapped on Ravnica by the Immortal Sun and fights Sorin before a temporary truce against the Eternals.
events.quote: they later came to a temporary truce, joining forces against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde

events.summary: Nahiri hires adventurers and uses the Lithoform Core, killing Zareth and pushing Akiri off the ruin.
events.quote: Nahiri used the artifact to defend herself but killed Zareth in the process.

events.summary: Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind during the battle with Nissa at the focal point.
events.quote: Jace turned the tables on her and took control of her mind

events.summary: Nissa uses the Lithoform Core to heal Zendikar and restore its wild nature, and Nahiri swears revenge on Jace.
events.quote: Nissa had used the power of the Lithoform Core to heal the damage done by the Eldrazi and restore Zendikar's wild nature

events.summary: On New Phyrexia Nahiri is infected with phyresis after protecting Kaito and the Wanderer.
events.quote: She won but sustained a wound that infected her with phyresis .

events.summary: Nahiri sacrifices herself, cleaving Sheoldred's Coliseum from the Dross Pits and dropping it on the Fair Basilica.
events.quote: she cleaved the Coliseum from the Dross Pits and dropped it with all remaining planeswalkers on the Fair Basilica

events.summary: Elesh Norn compleats Nahiri.
events.quote: she was subsequently compleated by Elesh Norn

events.summary: Elesh Norn sends compleated Nahiri to conquer Zendikar; she reactivates the Emeria Skyclave and realigns the hedrons to call Realmbreaker, fusing with the stones.
events.quote: she fused herself with the stones in the center, becoming its keystone

events.summary: Tazri's party, empowered by Halo, breaks Nahiri loose and the Skyclave crashes with her inside.
events.quote: the Skyclave broke and crashed to the ground with her still inside

events.summary: Nahiri wakes freed of corruption, removes most Phyrexian parts, and her spark's hedron is crushed when she falls on it, leaving her desparked.
events.quote: crushing the hedron containing her spark in the process

events.summary: Nahiri vows that planeswalkers will never set foot on Zendikar again.
events.quote: She vowed that planeswalkers would never set foot on Zendikar again.

events.summary: Nahiri returns to Innistrad, restores Markov Manor and meets Ajani and Arlinn, who is hunting her.
events.quote: Having learned that Nahiri was on Arlinn's hit list, he placed himself between them to prevent them from fighting.

relations.note: He mentored and raised her as a planeswalker.
relations.quote: Viewing her almost as a daughter, Sorin taught Nahiri about the Multiverse

relations.note: A brutal feud after his broken promise.
relations.quote: This led to a rather brutal feud between the two.
She was one of The Three
Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone hedrons

relations.note: Nissa turned against her over restoring the Kor-era stability.

relations.quote: swearing revenge on Jace for his meddling
she was subsequently compleated by Elesh Norn

relations.note: She was sent to conquer Zendikar for New Phyrexia.
relations.quote: Elesh Norn sent the compleated Nahiri to Zendikar to conquer her homeplane in the name of New Phyrexia.

relations.note: Nahiri called Ajani her new friend.
relations.quote: she bid her new friend Ajani goodbye

relations.note: Nahiri was on Arlinn's hit list.
relations.quote: Nahiri was on Arlinn's hit list

relations.note: She intervened against Nahiri's threat to Innistrad.
relations.quote: who sensed the threat that Nahiri posed to Innistrad
